features.description: No-workbench concept activity, end-to-end: teacher creates a from-scratch chat-only Socratic activity (workbench_type=none), mints a group code, student joins and chats. Extends ActivityConfig + the existing /api/activity-configs upsert (with activity-id minting) + teacher builder UI + aiplatform activity CLI.
acceptance_criteria: ActivityConfig has workbench_type (Literal app/drawing/sensor/video/notebook/none, default none) + source_activity_id; legacy rows read back unchanged; paired_workbench-set backfills to app
POST /api/activity-configs accepts workbench_type and mints an activity_id under a teacher: slug namespace when none supplied; owner-only (cross-teacher 403); extra=forbid body extended so no 422
aiplatform activity new --type none and activity list work end-to-end (new cli/aiplatform/commands/activity.py)

Teacher builder (frontend/src/app/teacher/activities/new + extended [id]/page.tsx) has name/language/difficulty/lesson-prompt, workbench-type select defaulting to none, first-run concept-dialogue default, and designed empty/loading/error states
Student renders chat-only Socratic session when workbench_type=none (no workbench pane); lesson prompt drives the tutor
MANUAL (LOCAL_MODE): teacher creates a no-workbench activity in <5 min, mints a code, anon student joins and has a Socratic chat
cd backend && make lint && make test-fast green; cd frontend && npm run quality:check green
features.notes: M0.0 reconciles the design doc API section to the real /api/activity-configs surface and answers Q1 as (A) promote ActivityConfig.
